text: Grab's FY2025 report (Item 3. Risk Factors) states that in Indonesia, media speculation suggests the government is considering a draft presidential decree that would lower the current 20% commission cap (made up of a 15% commission cap plus a 5% optional supporting fee cap under Ministry of Transportation Decree No. 667 of 2022, as amended) to a flat 10% commission cap on driver-partners. The draft decree would also reclassify driver-partners as quasi-employees, requiring Grab to fund accident/death insurance and contribute to health, old-age and pension premiums, and would let the government review driver-partner agreements and protect their right to unionize — changes Grab says would increase costs, reduce margins and diminish operational flexibility [Grab, FY2025, p.16].
